test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 03 Dec 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, 'LAPTOP' is written as ‘JYNRMN’ and ‘COLD’ is written as ‘AMJB’, how will 'SKETCHPEN' be written in that language?
solution:
The position of the English alphabet series is given below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/af7f5248a0c6050307cf17b8c83db8e491536f519fe8ba8a2eb262575c9e9f06.png] 

'LAPTOP' is written as ‘JYNRMN’ 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c39b2a32a92372ba4397bfad9f04a66c8b83fe47189b9495a18315cada4f4f46.png] 

And,

‘COLD’ is written as ‘AMJB’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d087950b92eeb976ff7e62dfddf6c1b7ab5b5834ce9cd7a8cea389a6bb00de47.png] 

Similarly,

'SKETCHPEN' be written as '?'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/607d200d28ba02ce0cbb709f1d3f811a9fcb5c659e5ce3297759b5974b070b2e.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"QICRAFNCL".**
